subject: Copywriting
title: Jeff Goodby: Got Milk?
description: A fast breakdown of Jeff Goodby: Got Milk? for builders.

hook.text: Jeff Goodby's 'Got Milk?' campaign turned a declining commodity into a cultural icon. Two words and a milk mustache.

buildup.text: The California Milk Processor Board was desperate. Milk sales had fallen for 20 straight years. Goodby took the brief.

discovery.text: The insight: people only think about milk when they run out. The ads showed moments of deprivation—dry cereal, cookies.

twist.text: Celebrity milk mustache photos became the real campaign. Stars lined up for free. The format became self-sustaining.

climax.text: 'Got Milk?' was licensed, parodied, and became part of the language. It's the most imitated ad format in history.

punchline.text: Two words saved an industry. Got Milk? Got genius.

quiz.question: What insight drove the 'Got Milk?' campaign?
options: People only think of milk when they don't have it
